limitations: No guarantee against platform-wide cleanup, service/session namespace reset, SIGKILL, host restart or storage loss.
Post-launch Python or I/O failure can leave an owned driver alive without ACTUAL_RETURN; inspect owned process identities and build lock before retry.

Child /proc start ticks are an optional observation: a short-lived child can disappear before inspection. PID/start ticks are meaningful only in their observed PID namespace; cross-namespace observation may differ.
The script fsyncs files/output directory but does not fsync the parent entry of the newly created output directory. No hard power-loss durability claim.
Full log is read into memory for final SHA; acceptable for this selected builder output, not a universal bound for arbitrary drivers.
properties: Exact spec SHA and driver SHA checked before launch. Complete reviewed builder argv/cwd and its internal resource/admission/watchdog logic are unchanged.
New canonical output directory and exclusive metadata/log creation. Full child stdout/stderr is file-backed; actual child return is obtained from Popen.wait, then log and result metadata are fsynced.
Missing result is explicitly UNKNOWN, never inferred success from stale builder metadata.
Whole supervisor detached by parent launch, rather than detaching a raw compiler or bypassing the builder.
scope: Exact selected builder launch only; any future checker wrapper invocation requires its own reviewed exact spec and unchanged watchdog.
validation_basis: Static inspection of exact source/spec and owner-provided six synthetic exit0/exit7/stdout smoke report. No supervisor launch, process signal, control mutation or Lean/checker execution by reviewer.
